compartment.title: Phase 5-6 verification complete — no refactors needed, committed
compartment.p1:
Confirmed `applyConversationEvent` and `reduceSessionState` are already clean dispatch tables (Pattern A) — no changes needed. `event-helpers.ts` is 3 small functions with no anonymous complexity hotspots.
Moved to Phase 6 assessment: CLI/orchestrator/observability/renderers/models/scripts complexity. Read target files — `scripts` and `renderers` packages are empty (source code removed). `buildRecommendation` in `packages/models/src/index.ts` is linear score computation with no nested branches or loops to flatten. All remaining Phase 5 items confirmed clean: event-helpers.ts (3 small exported functions with inline map callbacks, acceptable), vscode mock (`Uri` class + interface, trivial).
Phase 6 assessment: all targets either already have suppressions, structurally linear, or packages are empty. No refactors needed.
Ran type checks on edited packages — all clean. Ran tests — all passing. Committed Phase 5-6 completion via `but_gitbutler_update_branches`.
Read `plan/agentsy-quality.md` to scope remaining phases. Plan contains Phases 1 (security: release.yml tag input, esbuild CVE, hardcoded test secret), 4 (provider/gateway/core complexity), 5-6 (done), 8 (docs/lockfiles), 9 (SonarCloud cognitive complexity/insecure randomness/PATH hardening), 10 (scanner config — excludes `.agents/` from all scanners), and 11 (dead code/unused exports). Remaining phases to assess: 1, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11.
